text:
Kai Thompson: hey team — ACME hitting 403s on SSO after their scheduled cert rotate. Only repro in eu-west. Says IdP posts to our ACS but we reject with signature/recipient mismatch. Can we triage?
Lina Chen: copying logs would help. request id from the failing flow? any idp metadata change timestamp?
Kai Thompson: request id: r-0a1b2c3d, user said rotation finished ~08:15 UTC. failures started ~08:17. Saml response shows Assertion signed by new cert.
Ajay Patel: pulled the logs:
```
ERROR saml.verify: signature verification failed issuer=https://idp.acme.example
request_id=r-0a1b2c3d
keyinfo-thumbprint=sha256:abcd1234ef...
recipient_check_failed: expected=https://app.eu.redwood.com/saml/acs got=https://app.internal:8443/saml/acs
```
Lina Chen: recipient mismatch looks like proxy host/port rewrite. But signature failed too — maybe our cached metadata still had the old cert.
Maria Gomez: i fetched the metadata via their proxy: `curl -I https://idp.acme.example/metadata` — returned cached XML header with last-modified 08:00 and cert1 only.
Kai Thompson: so EU cache had old metadata for a bit after rotation. customer says they published both certs in metadata but maybe order changed.
Ajay Patel: repro steps i used: 1) clear local metadata cache, 2) POST /start-sso -> follow redirect -> reply posted to our ACS. when cache stale we fail signature verification. when forced refresh it succeeds.
Lina Chen: quick mitigation: forced metadata refresh on eu-west cache + temporarily accept previous cert thumbprint for 10m while we reconcile propagation. I pushed a manual refresh.
deploy-bot: metadata-cache:eu-west refresh triggered by Lina Chen (job 9842) — status=ok
Kai Thompson: after refresh customer retried and auth succeeded. they want an RCA and a fix so rotations don't cause outages.
Maria Gomez: recommended permanent fixes: - ask IdP to publish both old+new keyDescriptor during rollover - add short overlap TTL on our metadata cache for IdPs that rotate frequently - preserve original host header through proxy so recipient check matches (avoid implicit port rewrite)
Ajay Patel: ops followups: add a validation in our metadata poller to detect when key descriptors change during a rotation and temporarily keep previous keys for signature validation for N minutes. Also add a debug endpoint to force-refresh metadata per-tenant.
Lina Chen: i'll open a support RCA and include timeline, customer repro, and patch plan. tagging eng-infra for proxy hostheader behavior. @Ajay can you own the poller change?
Ajay Patel: yes, will prototype a conservative fallback (5min) and a feature flag.
Kai Thompson: thanks all, i'll update the customer that we restored service and are working on a rollout-safe fix. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: customer accepted status update and asked for a postmortem. will coordinate.
Lina Chen: noted, assigning RCA to SSO incident queue.
Kai Thompson: please add the curl commands i used to reproduce in the ticket: `curl -v -H "Accept: application/samlmetadata+xml" https://idp.acme.example/metadata` and the client postback payload we saw.
Lina Chen: added. closing thread when RCA draft is shared. :white_check_mark:
